title: 第21章 回归第22章 五毒教
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
秦猛怒发冲冠，凶猛的一拳撼动天地！
“看你的拳头硬，还是我的拳头硬！”
“神龙臂！”
林白没有在留手，看见秦猛如此厉害的一拳袭击而来。
当即施展了自己手中最强的武技。
气血之力凝聚在手臂上，在林白一声怒吼之间，轰然砸出。
嘭的一声！
真武境一重的秦猛，居然被林白的这一拳打飞出去，落在十米之外。
“你这武技……！”秦猛被林白的这一招武技吓得说不出话来。
“你不是要杀我吗？来呀，我们看看是谁杀谁！”
一拳得手，林白手执斩灵剑便冲了上去。
秦猛瞧见林白已经起了杀心，顿时惊叫道：“好汉饶命，好汉饶命，我只是一时糊涂而已，求你不要杀我，不要杀我。”
“只要你不杀我，这擎天盟中的一切都是你的。”
“我有很多的灵石财宝，很多的灵花灵草。”
“对了，我现在洞府中还有一百多个从山下掳来的良家妇女，还有一半是处子，我还没有碰过。”
“你要是喜欢，都送给你了。”
擎天盟的武者都以为老盟主是在闭关修炼。
可谁会想到，这老东西以闭关之名，在偷偷的玩弄妇女。
其实在多年前，秦猛就有这个癖好，希望玩弄女人，就连擎天盟内的女子武者，也有很多遭到他的毒手。
“一百多个掳来的良家妇女！”林白一听，双目发怒。

“对对对，你喜欢，都给你，都给你。”秦猛看林白好像很有兴趣，宛如抓住了救命稻草一般的说到。
“呵呵呵，你们一家，真的该死！”
林白一咬牙，飞冲上去，果断的一剑击杀了秦猛。
“呃…，我什么都给你了，你为什么还要杀我！”秦猛难以置信的看着林白。
林白冷声道：“做了这么多畜生事情，我真是后悔没有找点杀了你！”
“你！你会不得好死的！”
“你知道赵容是什么人吗？”
秦猛在临死前狰狞的笑道。
“赵容？秦向天的妻子？”林白好奇的看着秦猛。
赵容这个女人，一声毒功十分了得，尤其是那一套《五毒掌》，让林白差点都吃了苦头。
“哈哈，你会被五毒教抓住，丢进毒窟，永世不得超生的！”秦猛在说出最后一句话之后，死不瞑目的倒在了地上。
五毒教！
这是在神武国内的一个庞大的邪教，以杀人为乐，手段极其残忍。
曾经神武国联合四大宗门，围剿数年，都未能将五毒教完成的铲除。
“难道赵容和五毒教有关系？”林白心中有些狐疑的自言自语着。
“老盟主，老盟主！”齐盛看见老盟主死在了自己的面前，顿时吓得丢魂落魄。
真武境一重的秦猛都死在了林白的手里，齐盛不过是一个武道境的武者而已，如何能逃出林白的手中？
齐盛反而是从地上站起来，冰冷的笑着：“林白，你以为我会对你跪地求饶吗？你做梦！”
“我死，也不会向你下跪的！”
“我跟你拼了！”

齐盛怒吼一声，飞冲而来。
“聒噪！”林白剑身一扬，直径斩碎齐盛的咽喉，将齐盛斩杀。
齐盛这人，身在斩妖盟，却是擎天盟的卧底。
对于一个叛徒，林白可是不会心慈手软的！
擎天盟的大战持续了整整的一夜。
content_en:
Qin Meng was furious and shook the world with a fierce punch!
"Whether your fist is stronger or mine is stronger!"
"Dragon Arm!"
Lin Bai did not hold back when he saw Qin Meng coming with such a powerful punch.
He immediately used his strongest martial arts skills.
The power of qi and blood condensed on his arm, and when Lin Bai roared, he smashed it out.
Bang!
Qin Meng, who was at the first level of the True Martial Realm, was actually knocked out by Lin Bai's punch and landed ten meters away.
"Your martial arts...!" Qin Meng was so frightened by Lin Bai's martial arts that he was speechless.
"Aren't you going to kill me? Come on, let's see who kills whom!"
After succeeding with one punch, Lin Bai rushed forward with the Spirit-Slaying Sword in hand.
When Qin Meng saw that Lin Bai had murderous intentions, he immediately screamed: "Hero, spare your life, hero, spare your life, I was just confused for a moment, please don't kill me, don't kill me."
"As long as you don't kill me, everything in this Qingtian Alliance will be yours."
"I have a lot of spiritual stone treasures, a lot of spiritual flowers and spiritual grass."
"By the way, I still have more than a hundred good women kidnapped from the mountains in my cave, and half of them are virgins. I haven't touched them yet."
"If you like it, I'll give it to you."
The warriors of the Qingtian Alliance all thought that the old alliance leader was practicing in seclusion.
But who would have thought that this old guy was secretly playing with women in the name of seclusion.
In fact, many years ago, Qin Meng had this hobby, hoping to play with women. Even many female warriors in the Qingtian League were poisoned by him.
"More than a hundred captive women from good families!" When Lin Bai heard this, his eyes became angry.
"Yes, yes, if you like it, I'll give it all to you, give it all to you." Qin Meng saw that Lin Bai seemed very interested and said as if he was grasping a life-saving straw.
"Hahaha, your family really deserves to die!"
Lin Bai gritted his teeth, rushed forward, and killed Qin Meng with a decisive sword blow.
"Uh..., I've given you everything, why do you still want to kill me!" Qin Meng looked at Lin Bai in disbelief.
Lin Bai said coldly: "You have done so many beastly things, I really regret not finding something to kill you!"
"You! You will die badly!"
"Do you know who Zhao Rong is?"
Qin Meng smiled ferociously before he died.
"Zhao Rong? Qin Xiangtian's wife?" Lin Bai looked at Qin Meng curiously.
This woman, Zhao Rong, was very good at poisoning, especially the set of "Five Poison Palms", which almost made Lin Bai suffer.
"Haha, you will be caught by the Five Poison Sect and thrown into the poison cave, and you will never be reincarnated!" After Qin Meng said the last words, he fell to the ground with a look of death.
Five Poison Sect!
This is a huge cult in the Shenwu Kingdom. It enjoys killing people and its methods are extremely cruel.
The Shenwu Kingdom once united the four major sects and conducted an encirclement and suppression campaign for several years, but they were unable to completely eradicate the Five Poison Sect.
"Is Zhao Rong related to the Five Poison Sect?" Lin Bai said to himself with some suspicion.
"Old leader, old leader!" Qi Sheng was frightened and lost his mind when he saw the old leader died in front of him.
Qin Meng, who was at the first level of the True Martial Realm, died in Lin Bai's hands. Qi Sheng was just a martial artist at the Martial Arts Realm. How could he escape from Lin Bai's hands?
Instead, Qi Sheng stood up from the ground and smiled coldly: "Lin Bai, do you think I will kneel down and beg for mercy from you? You are dreaming!"
"I won't kneel down to you even if I die!"
"I'll fight you!"
Qi Sheng roared angrily and rushed over.
"Noisy!" Lin Bai raised his sword, chopped Qi Sheng's throat in diameter, and killed Qi Sheng.
Qi Sheng is in the Demon Slayer League, but he is an undercover agent of the Qingtian League.
Lin Bai would not be merciful to a traitor!
The battle between the Qingtian Alliance lasted the whole night.
